fullPassage: The graph above shows the proportion of student housing by accommodation type for selected study destinations in 2022. Notably, Other Private Accommodations made up the largest share of student housing, except in the UK, where PBSAs were the most common type. Among the study destinations, the UK had the highest percentage of University Accommodations and PBSAs. University Accommodations were used by fewer than one-third of students in every study destination, with Australia showing the lowest proportion. Australia showed the greatest difference between University Accommodations and PBSAs, with a 10-percentage-point gap, while the USA showed the smallest difference, with a 1-percentage-point gap. Europe was the only study destination where the percentage of PBSAs was greater than that of University Accommodations, showing the opposite pattern to the other study destinations.

Notably, Other Private Accommodations made up the largest share of student housing, except in the UK, where PBSAs were the most ____ type. Among the study destinations, the UK had the highest percentage of University Accommodations and PBSAs. University Accommodations were used by fewer than one-third of students in every study destination, with Australia showing the lowest proportion. Australia showed the greatest difference between University Accommodations and PBSAs, with a 10-percentage-point gap, while the USA showed the smallest difference, with a 1-percentage-point gap. Europe was the only study destination where the percentage of PBSAs was greater than that of University Accommodations, showing the opposite pattern to the other study destinations.
questions.stem:
윗글의 내용을 한 문장으로 요약하고자 한다. 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

While Other Private Accommodations generally __(A)__ student housing, the UK stood out with PBSAs being the most __(B)__ type.

det.analysis:
✅ ③ dominated — common: 원문 요약 일치
❌ ① decreased: 감소 아님
